feature_queries.name: time
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  e.display_id,
  e.timestamp,
  EXTRACT(hour FROM e.timestamp) AS hour_of_day,
  EXTRACT(dow FROM e.timestamp) AS day_of_week
FROM eval_table e

feature_queries.name: ad_meta
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  e.display_id,
  e.timestamp,
  pc.campaign_id,
  pc.advertiser_id
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN PromotedContent pc ON e.ad_id = pc.ad_id

feature_queries.name: ad_hist_prior10
feature_queries.sql:
WITH global AS (SELECT AVG(clicked*1.0) AS gctr FROM train_table),
clicks_labeled AS (
  SELECT c.ad_id, c.timestamp, tt.clicked
  FROM Click c
  JOIN train_table tt
    ON tt.display_id=c.display_id
   AND tt.ad_id=c.ad_id
   AND tt.timestamp=c.timestamp
), agg AS (
SELECT
  e.display_id,
  e.timestamp,
  COUNT(cl.clicked) AS ad_imps,
  SUM(cl.clicked) AS ad_clicks,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cl.timestamp >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '1 day' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ad_imps_1d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cl.timestamp >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 day' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ad_imps_7d,
  AVG(CASE WHEN cl.timestamp >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '1 day' THEN cl.clicked*1.0 END) AS ad_ctr_1d
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN clicks_labeled cl
  ON cl.ad_id = e.ad_id
 AND cl.timestamp < e.timestamp
GROUP BY e.display_id, e.timestamp
)
SELECT
  a.display_id,
  a.timestamp,
  a.ad_imps,
  a.ad_clicks,
  LN(1 + a.ad_imps) AS log_ad_imps,
  LN(1 + a.ad_clicks) AS log_ad_clicks,
  (a.ad_clicks + 10 * (SELECT gctr FROM global)) / (a.ad_imps + 10) AS ad_ctr_smooth_10,
  a.ad_imps_1d,
  a.ad_imps_7d,
  a.ad_ctr_1d,
  CASE WHEN a.ad_imps > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_ad_hist,
  CASE
    WHEN a.ad_imps = 0 THEN 0
    WHEN a.ad_imps BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 1
    WHEN a.ad_imps BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN 2
    WHEN a.ad_imps BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN 3
    WHEN a.ad_imps BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN 4
    WHEN a.ad_imps BETWEEN 21 AND 50 THEN 5
    ELSE 6
  END AS ad_imps_bin,
  CASE
    WHEN (a.ad_clicks + 10 * (SELECT gctr FROM global)) / (a.ad_imps + 10) < 0.08 THEN 0
    WHEN (a.ad_clicks + 10 * (SELECT gctr FROM global)) / (a.ad_imps + 10) < 0.12 THEN 1
    WHEN (a.ad_clicks + 10 * (SELECT gctr FROM global)) / (a.ad_imps + 10) < 0.17 THEN 2
    WHEN (a.ad_clicks + 10 * (SELECT gctr FROM global)) / (a.ad_imps + 10) < 0.23 THEN 3
    WHEN (a.ad_clicks + 10 * (SELECT gctr FROM global)) / (a.ad_imps + 10) < 0.30 THEN 4
    ELSE 5
  END AS ad_ctr_bin
FROM agg a
